tasks.title: Harness ownership and context contract

existingEvidence.observation: A durable lead-discovery coordinator owns its own job schema, runtime and recovery; neighboring workflows have separate managers.
Website collection has a separate persisted job/task owner and recovery API.
Server initializes and recovers multiple vertical job managers independently.

testEvidence.observation: Source contains pause/resume/cancel/restart recovery coverage; not run for this mapping.

tasks.recommendation: Extend the selected durable job owner through a narrow HarnessTask/Result adapter. Keep existing lead, campaign, contact and evidence IDs as domain references; do not create a parallel state machine. No common immutable context manifest or cross-workflow owner was found.
tasks.migration: No harness tables exist to migrate. If a manifest is added, store versioned references to existing records and tenant/workspace identity; do not copy domain records into a new harness database.
tasks.nextAction: After S00/S05 and baseline selection, choose one workflow as the adapter pilot and specify immutable input/output references plus a single authoritative state owner.

tasks.title: Bounded execution and progress detection

existingEvidence.observation: Coordinator has runtime-budget termination and stops outstanding child work when the budget is reached.
Generation supports Ollama and optional Bedrock, including a Bedrock-to-Ollama fallback; this does not enforce the blueprint's GLM-5.3-only route.
Usage recorder explicitly accepts Ollama and Bedrock provider IDs.

testEvidence.observation: Source includes runtime-budget stop and child-cancel scenarios; not run for this mapping.
Source exercises Ollama usage and a Bedrock fixture; not run for this mapping.

tasks.recommendation: Reuse vertical runtime limits as inputs to a selected harness wrapper, then add call/tool/cost/deadline accounting, allowed-tool schemas, no-progress detection and a single repair cap. Require an explicit GLM-5.3 adapter and remove/disable hidden provider fallback for harness work only after provider decisions are approved.
tasks.migration: No cross-runtime budget reservation or task-level usage linkage was found. Add task IDs to existing usage events with nullable migration and preserve provider request records; do not rewrite historic cost rows.
tasks.nextAction: Define the harness provider and tool allowlist after X01; instrument one pilot and prove that budget exhaustion blocks follow-on effects.
blockers: S06/S07 are prerequisites.

Add versioned harness checkpoints referencing evidence, usage and policy versions, plus a deterministic completion rubric before terminal state. tasks.title: Decision record and state migration

existingEvidence.observation: Scoring returns a weighted site score and penalty-derived confidence and can replay prior scoring versions; it does not establish the extension's separate event probability, utility, risk and reversibility record.
A scoring replay endpoint and auditable qualification review decision route exist.
Source tests review decisions; not run for this mapping.

testEvidence.observation: Source checks deterministic versioned score and heuristic confidence penalties; not run for this mapping.

tasks.recommendation: Extend the existing qualification/review records with separately named nullable decision quantities, calibration target/action/horizon, evidence freshness and policy version. Keep abstention and denied policy explicit; never interpret model-reported confidence as probability.
tasks.migration: Do not reinterpret legacy confidence_score or ACT/BLOCK fields. Preserve old rows and add explicit fields/versioned translation; leave probability values null unless backed by calibrated, matching evidence.
tasks.nextAction: Inspect the full scoring and review schema after S13/S14 contracts are frozen; write a field-by-field legacy mapping before migration.
blockers: S13 and S14 semantics are prerequisites.

tasks.olderCheckoutDifference: Both checkouts have scoring/review concepts, but the newer source contains distinct dirty scoring-related changes; re-audit the older checkout independently before porting a schema.
